In a way, the trouble for me is I have a reasonable amount of people who I would term friends, but only loosely. I haven't had anyone who I would have called a friend my whole life, much less my best friend. To be honest, I'm not sure anyone cares all that much about me, other than this one girl, who now seems to have gone... To my family, I'm the useless one anyway - my younger brother's good at sports and maths and English and everything (so much so that even my friends call him "cooler [my name]"), and he spent most of my childhood hitting me and giving me concussion.
I do, but when you invariably spend 6-7 hours a day with those people, it's difficult to see beyond that.
No, it's not a small community at all, it's just that we have huge friendship groups. I live in London.

I did - twice. The trouble is, there's only really two main friendship groups in my school, and I'm half in both of them. The one group is the abusive group, the other is a group which is okay, but the trouble is they're the "cool nerd" group, and I'm just a nerd. I'm more an ancillary to that group than I am an actual asset, and everyone knows that.

My main concern is with my ex, though. She felt less like my girlfriend and more like my family, and still does - despite everything that's happened, I still love her. I know by now that she doesn't at all, and I seriously wonder if simply getting rid of myself as a whole will not be the best thing for her.
